exposure: Chewing xylitol-free gum for 30 minutes at 3, 5, and 7 hours post-cesarean section
outcome: time to first feeling of hunger
time to first passage of flatus
cohort: 150 patients undergoing cesarean sections, randomized into a gum chewing group (n=75) and a control group (n=75).
finding: Chewing gum at frequent intervals in the early postoperative period following a cesarean section led to an earlier return of bowel movements, shorter hospitalization, and increased patient satisfaction with bowel function compared to the control group.
